result:
Done. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (5 tests).

The bug was in `PostController.search()` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:36-47`): every condition lived inside a single `where(callback)` group, and the published check was added as `q.orWhere('published', true)` — so the generated SQL was `title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR published = true`. That both let unpublished keyword matches through (the OR never constrained them) and padded results with every published post regardless of the keywords. The fix pulls the published check out of the group into a top-level `.where('published', true)` AND-ed with the keyword group, which the ORM renders as `published = true AND (title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR …)`; the ORM's grouping semantics (`pushCallbackGroup` + `normalizeConditionSequence` in `@guren/orm`) wrap the OR chain in its own parenthesized node, so the AND holds for any number of keywords. I also replaced the placeholder note in `tests/PostController.test.ts` with a real feature suite: it migrates the test database, inserts a fixture author plus published/unpublished posts sharing the words `zephyrquill` and `marmalade`, a published post matching nothing, and a draft-only word `quillhaven`, then asserts single-keyword, multi-keyword, and draft-only-word searches return exactly the published matches (and cleans the fixtures up afterwards). I verified those three tests fail against the original code and pass against the fix; the pre-existing 422 validation test is unchanged.
